title: Physics backends
purpose: Newton runs evals; MuJoCo stays the reference backend and viewer path.

requirements.title: Newton is the primary physics backend
requirements.why: Newton keeps the whole contact graph live for the single-file kitchen scene

acceptance.text: newton_scene.build('kitchen.xml') loads the scene with G1 self-collisions off and room/prop/person contacts on
The kitchen keyframe qpos is applied to the Newton model so the G1 spawns standing in the aisle

requirements.title: MuJoCo reference backend
requirements.why: MuJoCo stays runnable for parity checks and the interactive viewer

acceptance.text: Executor loads kitchen.xml and steps the G1, props, and person with contacts measured
A scripted stand episode runs 5 seconds of sim with the robot upright

requirements.title: Scene composes open-source assets only
requirements.why: The kitchen is real authored geometry, not hand-drawn primitives

acceptance.text: kitchen.xml includes the generated assets/ithor_kitchen.xml, the Menagerie G1, and the person without redefining their meshes
At t=0 no two scene geoms penetrate deeper than 2 mm, upstream authoring excluded
kitchen.xml loads the rigged person asset produced by the NPC-1 pipeline, not the baked static OBJ
